ZeroWidthLimit.ClaimBoundary: The O(b^2) result is for the width-normalized average on a symmetric strip with a C4 transverse field. For uniformly bounded unscaled densities, the corresponding total-work remainder is O(b^3). Unsymmetric footprints or nonsmooth local fields may have a first-order or non-asymptotic normalized limit.
